The logger instance for output and diagnostics.

## Signature

```typescript
readonly log: Logger;
```

## Remarks

This logger is used throughout the lifecycle of actions collection to provide trace-level diagnostics for debugging template expansion, action instantiation, and variable substitution. It enables visibility into the lazy evaluation process without impacting runtime performance when tracing is disabled.
